products.title: DeerValley DV-1F52626 One-piece Toilets ADA-Compliant Seamless Easy-Clean Surface 1.28 GPF

description.html: This 1.28 GPF elongated one-piece toilet is a water-saving version of the industry-leading. The graceful, streamlined design will bring a supreme stylish style to the bath. The gently curved shape of the toilet complements all bathroom suites and decoration styles. The ceramic construction material, with its sleek white exterior, is durably constructed to be resistant to stains and abrasions for easy maintenance.
